confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregator sources (CityCost July 2026, AI and user-sourced; Numbeo-derived figures for other Mexican cities; one older Expat Exchange guide) and are medium quality. Guanajuato-specific data was thin. Beer, cocktail and wine were not found in search, so beer is a Mexico-wide estimate and cocktail and wine use the local beer ratio (about 2.5x and about 2.2x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX is the RBA observation for 15 Oct 2026 as shown in search excerpts of the RBA page; the page itself was not opened, and a 16 Oct value was not verified on an RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Guanajuato is a mid-sized colonial tourist city. Restaurant anchors are set below Mexico City and Playa del Carmen and close to Guadalajara and Puebla, based on the aggregator figures. Drink anchors follow Mexico-wide tourist-area pricing with a beer-based ratio for cocktail and wine. Accommodation follows a holistic model view of a historic Mexican city with many hostels and boutique hotels.
